snippet.title: Stellifier PV: An Idol Otome Visual Novel Game
snippet.description:
An idol drama game on Steam and iOS App store about an older group making a comeback from retirement. As a journalist, will you write the scoop of the year about their comeback or fall in love with them? The game features GxB / BXB romance! 

Available on Steam with a free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2911260/Stellifier__an_otome_game_inspired_by_older_idols/
